objectives.description: Run deploy-headless.sh to regenerate the deployed tree; confirm post-deploy presence of new files/sections
Scoped suite run (Batch Gate Deferral: --only, not full run-all.sh) confirming the new suite is discovered and passes in the deployed, merged tree
Scoped gate run (Batch Gate Deferral: --only-gate N --skip-unchanged, not the full 29-gate battery) covering the gates the plan names as needing particular attention
Live end-to-end --dry-run attestation with 4-note and 0-note fixtures

deviations.description: Plan's Phase 6 verification literally names 'bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh exits 0 ... across all 29 gates' and 'bash .claude/scripts/tests/run-all.sh' (unflagged full sweep)
deviations.reason: This dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive (in .dispatch/12.md, binding on every plan phase including this declared-tier=full one) requires discharging against a SCOPED tier instead: --only-gate N[,...] --skip-unchanged / --only SUITE[,...], recording the deferral, never an unflagged full sweep inside this dispatch. The complete gate set still runs exactly once for the whole batch at the end of the /orchestrate invocation and is attributed back to this task by its own modified_files -- the full gate is deferred, never forgiven. deploy-headless.sh's own embedded verify (--skip-slow, 40 checks) already ran as part of the deploy action itself and passed clean.

deviations.description: Including gate 8 in --only-gate triggered verify-deploy.sh's internal full, unflagged tests/run-all.sh --quiet --jobs auto sweep (all 203 suites) under its own specs/.gate-lock bracket -- exactly the mutex-contention/full-sweep waste the Batch Gate Deferral directive exists to prevent, and this run stalled for 580s+ with no progress
deviations.reason: Killed the run (and its already-dispatched job-worker children, which continued briefly as systemd-reparented orphans against throwaway /tmp fixtures before self-terminating) and released the stale specs/.gate-lock entry via 'task-lock.sh gate-release <token>' (the sanctioned release path verify-deploy.sh itself uses). Re-ran the scoped gate check WITHOUT gate 8 (--only-gate 3,4,5,22,29 --skip-unchanged) since gate 8's own content (the shell suite battery) was already covered, suite-scoped and gate-lock-free, by the earlier 'run-all.sh --only test-postflight-sapience-notes.sh,...' 8-suite run (8 passed, 0 failed). All 6 remaining gates (3,4,5,22,29) PASS in seconds once gate 8 was excluded, confirming gate 8 itself -- not a content defect -- was the sole cause of the stall.
